diagnostic: Multiple firsthand English-player accounts establish broad action and pacing tradeoffs, but Russian-language player reviews demonstrably exist and were not retrievable as inspected concrete review items; both the direct Russian filter and age-gated Steam product route remain inaccessible. The source-mix/Russian route and complete strict current-state localization coverage cannot be closed without inventing evidence; leave final_dossier null.

operations.summary: Verified the 2017 Full Clip edition AppID 501590 in independent exact Steam metadata search; direct store load redirected to an age gate, not an opened product page.
Independently inspected English player review cards praising fast linear action, silly combat and skillshots; other review cards describe dated design, diminishing novelty or control friction.

Located additional English review collection items including a firsthand complaint that novelty and combinations become repetitive, but did not treat the collection as date-explicit present-day technical evidence.
Exact Steam product metadata exposes a sizeable Russian player-review population, but aggregate counts do not expose any concrete player's observations.
Exact AppID Russian-language Steam Community review filter returned an access error, so no Russian-language player review was observed from that route.
Attempted opening official exact product; Steam returned only age-verification page and no technical/locale claim could be inferred from gated content.
